correctness.rationale: Unique feedback table for each de Bruijn n-cycle follows from the bijective successor permutation pairing states 0u and 1u. Lexicographically sorting all n-bit prefixes (each appears exactly once) makes consecutive BWT predecessor bits the complementary pair (m_j,1-m_j). Reversal turns each BWT predecessor into the ORIGINAL next bit of the reversed state, replacing suffix j by fixed-width bit-reversal rev_{n-1}(j). Exactly 2^{n-1} within-block letter changes yield run formula r=2^n-T(m); run count is linear, not cyclic. Independent enumeration visited ALL 2^16 order-five Boolean feedback masks, identified 2048 single-cycle tables, computed forward/reverse BWT directly from sorted rotations, checked both full strings against symbolic block transport, and reproduced the claimed nine-class difference spectrum 4,44,216,436,648,436,216,44,4. The all-order transport rests on symbolic proof, not the finite census.
